title: Enrollment Failed
description: Detects when the Autopilot enrollment has explicitly failed.
explanation:
The Autopilot enrollment has explicitly failed.

**Key facts from this session's events:**

- **Failure reason:** `{{reason}}`
- **First failed app:** `{{appName}}`
- **ESP step that failed:** `{{failedSubcategory}}`
- **ESP error code:** `{{errorCode}}`

A more specific finding in this analysis usually names the cause, such as an app, ESP or timeout finding.

remediation.title: Find the cause
steps: Open the finding in this analysis that names the cause (an app, ESP or timeout finding) and follow its steps
If no other finding fired, look up the ESP error code and check the failed ESP step in the session timeline
Verify the Autopilot profile and the ESP settings in Intune

presentation.summary: The enrollment failed at the ESP step {{esp_failure_subcategory.value}} with {{esp_failure_errorcode.value}}
